text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm working in my office as usual when...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll leave the documents here,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That's that. Now I just need to
check my
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hm? Did something fall down?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! This is...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hot springs! Trainer, let's go to the hot
springs!
We won that hot spring vacation
ticket,
remember?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
We should take this chance while we
have it! You
pick a date, and I'll fit it
into my schedule!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Ines Fujin and I decide to take a
trip to
the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for visiting our

establishment today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Dinner will be served from six in the
evening, so
please enjoy your stay until
then.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I was just practicing my customer
service. I
can't even remember how many
times I've worked
part-time shifts at an
inn.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Trainer, your room is
super
huuuge! And the view from your
window is
beautiful! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm kinda jealous... Hey, change rooms
with me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you just don't get it! Even a slight
difference
in angle can completely
change things.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Do you want some tea, by the way? I've
got
nothing to do, so I can give you a
massage or
something if you want.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. Then it's time for me
to kick
back!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Say, Trainer. What time is it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What?! Seriously?! It feels we've been
here for
like three hours already!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Has time slowed down or something? Is
this
what staying at an inn is always like?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's true. I'd normally be standing
behind a
register or running along a
racetrack right about
now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If I were still living at home, I'd probably
be out
shopping for dinner. Or maybe
helping my little
sisters with their
homework?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But it's just us right now—no customers
or sisters.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's so quiet... All you can hear is the
gentle hum
of the breeze and the sound
of footsteps on the
tatami mats.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I might go take a dip in the hot
springs. Do you
want to come along,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That felt sooo good! ♪ It wasn't
crowded
either, so I got the chance to
really stretch my
legs! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haha... There's seriously nothing to do
until
dinner time, huh.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: A nap? That feels like a waste, though...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
We might never get an opportunity like
this
again. It's like the calm before the
storm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Say, Trainer. Seeing as we've both got
time on
our hands, let's go for a stroll.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's nice and cool. Perfect for when
you've just
gotten out of a hot bath.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it was fine. I've just got warm
fuzzies left
over from the bath, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... The time usually flies by, but
today has
gone really slowly.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Once we go home, it'll be back to the
hustle and
bustle of everyday life...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But you know what...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I guess a busy life just suits my daily
rhythm
better, somehow.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So I think I'm looking forward to getting
back to
the academy and those hectic
days packed with
races, work, and
training.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've actually got a teensy request. Would
you do
it for me?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Don't get all suspicious about it! Just say
"yes"
already!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Geez, sometimes I don't know what to
do with
you. Let me rephrase it, then.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Will you continue to support me as my
trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Great to hear! ♪ I'm excited for
what the
future will bring! ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I hope the days we spend together
never come to an
end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Ines Fujin and I have formed
an
irreplaceable bond during this time
together.
